channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PL recupera fôlego na corrida presidencial e anuncia vice sem atrativo eleitoral
item.description: The PL regained momentum in the presidential race with the announcement of a running mate, though lacking significant electoral appeal, according to recent reports. The news energized the campaign of Flávio Bolsonaro, the party's presidential candidate, signaling a potential reversal of negative polling trends. However, the vice-presidential pick did not generate substantial new electoral momentum.

item.title: Sem candidato a presidente, mas com Tarcísio, Republicanos lidera em doação
item.description: The Republicans party, led by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, is the top recipient of business donations in Brazil in 2024, despite not having a presidential candidate defined for the 2026 elections. The party's financial strength reflects support from business sectors aligned with the governor's liberal-conservative agenda in São Paulo, even without an official presidential candidacy.

item.title: Corinthians busca remontada contra o Internacional; veja odds
item.description: Corinthians needs a comeback against Internacional to advance to the Copa do Brasil quarterfinals after losing 2-0 in the first leg. The team must win by at least two goals to force penalties or three for direct advancement. Despite being the home favorite, Corinthians has a poor recent record against Internacional at home, with only one win in their last five encounters.

item.title: Escolhido vice de Flávio Bolsonaro, Alfredo Gaspar terá missão de reforçar palanques da chapa no Nordeste
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, federal deputy from PL-AL, was chosen as the running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, with the mission of strengthening the campaign in the Northeast, a region where Bolsonarism historically struggles against Lula. His agenda includes planned trips to Paraíba, Pernambuco, Alagoas, and Bahia to boost the ticket's presence in the first round. Gaspar’s background as a former prosecutor and public security secretary is expected to bolster Flávio’s security agenda and the INSS CPI-related pension discount investigations.

item.title: As bets, o que fazer?
item.description: A poll conducted on Noblat’s blog showed that 90.2% of 926 readers agreed with the proposal to ban bets in Brazil to counteract the harms of gambling addiction, while only 9.8% disagreed. The result reflects strong public support for stricter regulatory measures against online betting.

item.title: TSE dá mais prazo à Meta em ação do PL contra perfis ‘fantasmas’ de ataques a Flávio
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques granted Meta an additional three days to preserve data from 51 Facebook and Instagram pages under investigation in a PL lawsuit alleging a digital militia of 'phantom' profiles targeting party affiliates, particularly Flávio Bolsonaro. The extension aims to ensure evidentiary integrity. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Representação contra vice de Flávio após acusação de estupro na CPI do INSS está parada no Congresso
item.description: Three ethics complaints involving Alfredo Gaspar, the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, remain stalled in Congress since late March following a heated exchange during the INSS CPMI closing session, where Lindbergh Farias called Gaspar a 'rapist'. Gaspar denies the allegations and has filed a lawsuit at the STF against Lindbergh and Soraya Thronicke, who claim to have submitted evidence to the Federal Police. The parliamentary ethics processes in both the Chamber and Senate have seen no progress.

item.title: Em jantar para selar reaproximação, Lula e Alcolumbre deixam discussão sobre 6x1 para depois das eleições
item.description: At a dinner at Minister Alexandre de Moraes's residence, Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre sought to repair their relationship following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias's STF nomination. Mediated by Moraes and Cristiano Zanin, the meeting focused on restoring institutional dialogue, with the 6x1 work schedule reform mentioned only in passing and deemed unsuitable for advancement during the electoral period.

item.title: TSE, TST e MPT lançam Aliança pelo Voto Livre e Secreto
item.description: The TSE, TST, and MPT launch the Alliance for Free and Secret Vote to combat electoral harassment in the workplace, featuring a national campaign with the slogan 'My vote, my choice' and a Technical Cooperation Agreement. The initiative aims to educate citizens and institutions about electoral harassment and promote preventive actions, including online adherence and customizable campaign materials.

item.title: Com vice definido, Flávio mira nova fase e reorganiza a campanha
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) running mate resolves the ticket’s main outstanding issues and launches a new campaign phase focused on electoral strategy, travel agenda, and defining Gaspar’s role. The campaign aims to move past failed Centrão negotiations, controversies involving Michelle Bolsonaro, and tensions with Daniel Vorcaro, prioritizing public safety as its core theme — strengthened by Gaspar’s background as a former prosecutor, Alagoas public security secretary, and INSS CPMI rapporteur.

item.title: PT aposta em candidaturas jovens para ampliar presença no Congresso
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) is betting on young candidates to renew its caucus in the Chamber of Deputies and strengthen Lula’s government support in Congress. The 'People's Congress' movement, led by councilwoman Luna Zarattini, brings together 37 young candidates advocating for the end of the 6×1 work scale, combating gender-based violence, and reforming parliamentary amendments, emphasizing diversity in gender, race, and social background.

item.title: Mesmo após convenções, partidos ainda podem mudar chapas
item.description: Although party conventions ended on August 5, parties can still adjust their tickets for the 2026 elections until August 15, the final deadline for candidate registration with the Electoral Justice. This flexibility allows for resolving regional impasses, filling open vacancies, and defining coalitions, provided it was foreseen in the convention minutes. Substitutions of already homologated candidates are only allowed in specific cases, such as resignation, death, or registration denial.

item.title: Vice de Flávio torce para que STF agilize investigação sobre estupro
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), Flávio Bolsonaro’s vice-presidential running mate, urges the STF to expedite an investigation into a rape allegation made by PT and PSB lawmakers. Gaspar denies the claims and has submitted his DNA for comparison with that of the alleged 13-year-old victim. The case, assigned to Minister Gilmar Mendes, awaits a statement from the PGR and remains under secrecy.

item.title: Marqueteiro quer Flávio Bolsonaro somente nos debates com Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s newly hired strategist, Duda Lima, advised that the candidate should only participate in televised debates where President Lula is also present, to maximize direct confrontation. The approach aims to highlight Lula’s controversial remarks about women to attract female voters, while the campaign team is still being assembled and no final decision has been made on the debate strategy.

item.title: PT inicia campanha para levar militância a ato em São Bernardo
item.description: The Workers' Party launched a social media campaign to mobilize militants for the re-election campaign launch event of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, scheduled for August 16 at the 1º de Maio Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo. Titled 'Lula: where it all began', the event references the Vila Euclides neighborhood, where Lula rose as a union leader during the 1970s metalworkers' strikes. The PT framed the act as a return to its origins to begin what would be Lula’s fourth and final term, reaffirming commitments to democracy, national sovereignty, and social development.

item.title: Tarcísio passa recibo e piora a imagem das privatizações
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas accused the recently ended railroad workers' strike in his state of being politically motivated, noting that strikes inherently carry political weight and often intensify during election periods. He framed the accusations as a normal part of political contestation.

item.title: Após lavar “roupa suja”, Lula e Alcolumbre têm segundo encontro programado
item.description: Lula and Davi Alcolumbre held a second meeting following an initial tense encounter described by allies as 'washing dirty laundry'. The meeting aims to improve relations between the president and the Senate president. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Fifa lista 10 jogadores brasileiros como promessas de renovação para a Copa de 2030
item.description: FIFA released a list of ten Brazilian players aged 25 or younger, identified as prospects to renew the national team ahead of the 2030 World Cup. All had been called up by Carlo Ancelotti in the recent cycle but missed the 2026 World Cup due to injury or technical decision. The list spans all positions, with emphasis on four forwards and two midfielders, addressing perceived weaknesses in the current generation, particularly in midfield.

item.title: Mesmo com interferência estrangeira, disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro cheira a mofo
item.description: The presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro has officially begun, but aside from alleged interference attempts by Argentina and the United States, the rest of the electoral process appears stagnant and lacking novelty, described as 'smelling of mold'. The article notes that despite the formalization of tickets, vice-presidential choices, and TV time allocation, the political landscape lacks meaningful dynamism.

item.title: Gaspar na vice amplia irritação de aliados com Marinho após reveses nas negociações com o Centrão
item.description: The selection of deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate increased dissatisfaction among allies with campaign coordinator Rogério Marinho, who is criticized for failing to expand the coalition or secure additional TV time. Although Marinho was considered for the vice-presidential slot, he faced resistance from Eduardo Bolsonaro's allies, who feared his growing influence. Gaspar was chosen in a restricted negotiation involving Flávio, Valdemar Costa Neto, and Marinho, following last-minute discussions.

item.title: Tarifaço, rejeição, conservadores: os fatores que contribuem para a distância menor entre Lula e Flávio na Genial/Quaest
item.description: Lula maintains his lead in voting intentions, but his advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro has narrowed from 12 to 9 points in the first round and from 8 to 5 points in a potential runoff, according to the Genial/Quaest poll. The decline is linked to worsening voter perception of Lula’s response to U.S. tariffs, with 43% rating his reaction as 'bad' (vs. 38% as 'good'). The poll also reflects the effects of party conventions, the reconciliation between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro, and ongoing investigations into Lulinha, the president’s son.

item.title: Tarcísio tem mais de 50 encontros com executivos da Sabesp no mandato
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas held over 50 official meetings with Sabesp executives during his mandate, including president Carlos Augusto Piani and directors Roberval Tavares and Luciane Domingues, according to a Metrópoles analysis based on publicly disclosed agendas. The company was privatized under his administration, leading to increased profits but also customer complaints and accidents. The data, drawn from 3,106 agendas between January 2023 and June 2026, show that only 57% of meetings have complete participant information.

item.title: Nikolas tenta convencer Zema a desistir do Planalto e disputar Senado
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) attempted to persuade former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to abandon his 2026 presidential bid and run for the Senate instead, offering PL support for Governor Mateus Simões' (PSD) re-election in Minas Gerais, including the vice-presidential slot. Zema declined and maintained his presidential candidacy despite the pressure.

item.title: Tarcísio prioriza agendas com Arthur Lima, Derrite e Nunes no mandato
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas prioritizes meetings with political allies and secretaries in his official agenda, notably Arthur Lima (over 200 meetings), Guilherme Derrite (41 meetings), and Ricardo Nunes (22 recorded agendas). He also holds frequent meetings with Sabesp executives, the privatized basic sanitation company under his administration, which saw profit growth alongside increased customer complaints and accidents. The data is based on 3,106 official agendas from January 2023 to June 2026, analyzed by Fiquem Sabendo.

item.title: Greve na CPTM pode voltar? Entenda o acordo entre sindicato e governo
item.description: The CPTM railway workers' strike was ended after a conciliation hearing at the TRT-2, with 131 votes in favor and 26 against. The STEFZCB union maintained the strike state to pressure the São Paulo government to honor job security guarantees during CPTM's reorganization, as promised by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. Despite workers returning immediately, a new strike remains possible if commitments are not fulfilled.

item.title: DER-SP ignora alertas e paga R$ 136 milhões para demolir asfalto novo
item.description: The São Paulo State Highway Department (DER-SP) ignored alerts from the Gaeco and TCE-SP to pay R$136 million for demolishing 37 km of newly laid asphalt on the Péricles Bellini Highway, despite the pavement being less than two years old and lacking technical justification. The contract was signed in December 2024 under Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, following corruption alerts from November 2022, and stems from a bid issued during Rodrigo Garcia’s administration.

item.title: Série D ZeroUm: Goiatuba-GO e ASA-AL fazem confronto inédito pelo acesso
item.description: Goiatuba-GO and ASA-AL meet in the Série D ZeroUm quarterfinals in an unprecedented matchup in Brasileirão history. The first leg is scheduled for Saturday (8/8) at 6:30 PM at Estádio Divino Garcia Rosa, with the winner securing automatic promotion to Série C 2026. Both teams had strong campaigns: Goiatuba finished 2nd in Group A4 with 19 points (5W, 4D, 1L), while ASA-AL placed 3rd in Group A10 with 16 points (4W, 4D, 2L), having eliminated Sergipe, Ivinhema, and Cianorte to reach this stage.

item.title: La pelea con Trump y Milei da alas a la reelección de Lula en Brasil
item.description: Lula da Silva faces diplomatic crises with the U.S. and Argentina as he campaigns for re-election in 2026, blaming Flávio Bolsonaro — son of former president Jair Bolsonaro — for provoking foreign attacks. He seeks to turn international tensions into a domestic narrative of national sovereignty defense.

item.title: Republicanos confirma Soldado Sampaio como candidato ao governo de RR
item.description: The Republicanos party launched Soldado Sampaio's candidacy for governor of Roraima during a party convention on August 5. He assumed the governorship on an interim basis after Edilson Damião's mandate was annulled by the TSE and is contesting the supplementary elections, despite placing second with 35.72% of the vote, as the winning ticket of Arthur Henrique (PL) remains sub judice. Sampaio is a military police officer, accountant, and is serving his fourth consecutive term in the Roraima Legislative Assembly.

item.title: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam Romeu Zema, candidato à Presidência, nesta quinta; saiba como assistir
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for the Novo party, will be interviewed by g1 and GloboNews this Thursday (6) at 2 p.m. by journalists Andréia Sadi and Natuza Nery, in a live broadcast. The interview is part of a series featuring the top five candidates from the July 24 Datafolha poll, following Renan Santos (Missão) and preceding Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The full interview will be available on g1 (video) and the 'O Assunto' podcast (audio).

item.title: Entenda o peso das alianças partidárias para Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Partisan alliances directly affect the amount of free electoral propaganda time on TV and radio for the 2026 elections. Lula benefits from federations and coalitions with PCdoB, PV, PSB, PDT, and PSOL-Rede, increasing his access to resources and electoral airtime. Flávio Bolsonaro, despite lacking expected support from Podemos, Republicans, and the PP-União Brasil federation and forming a pure ticket with Alfredo Gaspar, will still have one of the largest propaganda times due to the PL’s strong federal bench in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Flávio diz que "fez duas filhas" para que elas cuidem dele na velhice
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he had two daughters so they would care for him in old age, during an event where he announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 election. The comment was made while discussing the unpaid care work predominantly performed by women, as part of a broader strategy to appeal to female voters, despite selecting a male running mate. Bolsonaro is the father of two teenage daughters, aged 14 and 12, with his wife, dentist Fernanda Bolsonaro.

item.title: PSDB oficializa candidatura de JHC ao governo de Alagoas
item.description: The PSDB Cidadania federation officially nominated João Henrique Caldas (JHC) as its candidate for governor of Alagoas in the 2026 elections, although JHC did not attend the event due to ongoing negotiations with allies, including a meeting with Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate for vice president. JHC reportedly considered shifting his bid from the state governorship to a Federal Senate seat. The full ticket, including the vice-governor and Senate candidates, remains to be finalized.

item.title: PGR rejeita pedido de apuração contra vice de Flávio por emendas
item.description: The PGR dismissed an investigation request against federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, due to lack of evidence linking him to irregularities in Pix amendments allocated to São José da Laje (AL). The decision held that indicating parliamentary amendments is a typical legislative function and that fund management rests with the municipality, with no concrete evidence tying Gaspar to the TCU-identified irregularities. The petitioner, deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), has 10 days to request reconsideration.

item.title: PGR pede à PF diligências sobre denúncia contra vice de Flávio
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) has requested preliminary investigative measures from the Federal Police (PF) before issuing an opinion on a request to open an inquiry against Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), nominated as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate for the Senate. The allegation, filed by Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS), claims Gaspar committed rape of a vulnerable person and has been submitted to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), where Minister Gilmar Mendes awaits the PGR's stance before deciding whether to authorize the investigation.

item.title: Lula telefona para se despedir de Petro antes de fim de mandato
item.description: President Lula called Colombian President Gustavo Petro to bid farewell before the end of his term, praising their productive cooperation and Petro’s commitment to sustainable development and regional integration. Both leaders celebrated the natural gas discovery at the Sandia-1 well by Petrobras and Ecopetrol, viewing it as an opportunity to deepen bilateral ties and enhance regional energy security. The call took place days before the inauguration of Abelardo de la Espriella, the right-wing election victor whose win marked the return of the right to power in Colombia after four years of leftist governance.

item.title: MG: após rompimento, União Progressista e Aro voltam à chapa de Simões
item.description: The União Brasil and Progressistas federation announced an alliance with the PSD to support Mateus Simões' candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, naming Danilo de Castro (União Brasil) as his running mate. Marcelo Aro (PP), who had broken with Simões to run for governor, is now running for Senate under the same coalition, alongside Carlos Viana (PSD) seeking re-election and a Novo party candidate referred to as 'Superman'. The deal was finalized with national party leadership support after tensions arose over PSD's exclusive backing.

item.title: Ancine abre processo contra produtora de filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Ancine has opened an administrative process against Go Up Entertainment for unauthorized filming of 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, in Brazil. The U.S.-based producer faces fines ranging from R$ 2,000 to R$ 100,000 for violating audiovisual regulations. The film, funded by Daniel Vorcaro and linked to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, had its request to delay release rejected by the TSE.

item.title: Lula defende a aliados investigação sobre assessor, mas diz ser normal fazer empréstimos
item.description: President Lula (PT) stated in a meeting with PSOL and Rede leaders that he supports the Federal Police investigation into his former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, for taking a R$249,000 loan from businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, but said personal loans are normal.

item.title: PT adia definição de vice de Patrus Ananias em Minas Gerais
item.description: The PT postponed the decision on the vice-gubernatorial candidate for Patrus Ananias’s ticket in Minas Gerais, continuing negotiations with Lula’s allied parties to broaden the coalition. The party aims to finalize alliances before the August 15 candidacy registration deadline, while Patrus expresses confidence in victory and stresses the need for alignment with the federal government. The event featured official support from Psol and confirmed Senate candidacies from Marília Campos (PT) and Áurea Carolina (Psol-Rede).

item.title: As duas boas notícias para Flávio em pesquisa, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his declining support trend, regaining ground among independent and non-Bolsonarist right-wing voters, while his base became more solidified, with around 70% of his supporters stating their vote is definitive, according to Guilherme Russo of Quaest.

item.title: Gilmar aguarda PF e PGR para decidir se autoriza inquérito contra vice de Flávio sob suspeita de estupro de vulnerável
item.description: STF Minister Gilmar Mendes is awaiting the conclusion of Federal Police investigations and a PGR opinion before deciding whether to authorize an inquiry against Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) on suspicion of rape of a vulnerable person. Gaspar was announced as the pre-candidate for vice president on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) 2026 ticket.

item.title: O que explica avanço de Flávio contra Lula em pesquisa, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: According to Quaest Intelligence Director Guilherme Russo, Flávio Bolsonaro’s gain against Lula in the Genial/Quaest poll stems from his reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro and the court-ordered ban on meetings between Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro, which appealed to non-bolsonarist right-wing and independent voters. Lula remains stable in polls with a high floor and low ceiling, making it difficult to increase his vote intention.

item.title: A informação que pode ter influenciado na escolha do vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate surprised campaign insiders, as there had been prior agreement to nominate Senator Rogério Marinho until the night before the announcement. According to columnist Robson Bonin, the decision was driven by strategic considerations: Gaspar's background as a public security prosecutor strengthens the bolsonarist discourse on safety, and his candidacy expands the ticket's reach in the Northeast—a region where Bolsonaro is weak and Lula holds strong electoral support. Bonin also noted that Gaspar, as rapporteur of the INSS CPMI, accessed confidential Federal Police files investigating Lula's allies and family, which could serve as a political asset in the campaign.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio diz que acusação contra vice é leviana e tenta tirar foco de Lulinha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign denies the accusation of sexual abuse of a minor against his running mate, Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), calling it flimsy and claiming it aims to divert attention from suspicions surrounding Fábio Luís, known as Lulinha, the president's son.

item.title: Secom: Lula vetou anistia a caminhoneiros que participaram de manifestações golpistas em 2022
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva vetoed amnesty for truckers who participated in post-2022 election coup attempts, as announced by Secom. The measure aims to prevent unequal treatment of those who attacked democracy, and is part of the Freight Provisional Measure.

item.title: Lula defende Marcola em reunião com aliados: 'Quem nunca pediu empréstimo para um amigo?'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended his former chief of staff, Marco Aurélio Ribeiro Santana, known as Marcola, during a meeting with allies from PSOL and Rede at the Palácio da Alvorada, stating, 'Who here has never asked a friend for a loan?' and emphasizing that Marcola has made his banking and fiscal records available to justice. The case involves suspected transfers from Roberta Luchsinger, a businesswoman under investigation in the INSS scandal, with whom Marcola admits having a personal loan and having paid R$ 249 thousand. Marcola stepped down from coordinating Lula’s campaign to focus on his defense, after serving a similar role in the 2022 campaign.

item.title: Flávio diz que teve duas filhas para cuidarem dele na velhice: 'vou ter quem vai tomar conta de mim'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he had two daughters specifically to care for him in old age, framing it as recognition of women's unpaid care work in childcare, housework, and elder support. He announced federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential running mate, emphasizing Gaspar's background in public security, while attempting to appeal to female voters, who make up 52.8% of the electorate. Although he had considered women like Tereza Cristina and Daniella Marques for the ticket, they were blocked by party neutrality, yet still voiced support for his candidacy at the event.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na entrevista de Renan Santos ao g1 e à GloboNews
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, was interviewed by g1 and GloboNews on August 5, claiming that 80% of youths in Febem who committed crimes lacked a male figure, citing a 2007 FGV study. The Fato ou Fake fact-check found that while the study notes paternal absence as a relevant factor in crime, it does not state that 80% of Febem inmates lacked a father figure or that this factor outweighs the Gini Index; the claim was deemed inaccurate and partially false.

item.title: MP do Frete: Lula veta anistia a caminhoneiros que bloquearam rodovias
item.description: President Lula signed into law the Freight MP, which establishes permanent rules for road freight transport oversight, but vetoed provisions granting amnesty to truckers involved in post-2022 election roadblocks and altering weight inspection rules. The veto preserves existing sanctions, ensures equal treatment, and upholds ANTT’s authority and legal certainty, according to the government.
